The polar bear is one of the world's largest predatory mammals. It weighs up to a ton and can be as long as 3 meters!
Kangaroo
The kangaroo lives in Australia and is well-known for the pouch on its belly used to cradle baby kangaroos.
Scarlet macaw
The scarlet macaw lives in South America and is a big and bright colored parrot, able to learn up to 100 words!
Moose
Being the largest of all the deers, the moose eats as much as 25 kg per day. However, it's not easy, so sometimes the moose has to stand on its hind legs to reach branches up to 4 meters!

Crocodile
The crocodile is a large amphibious reptile. It lives mostly in large tropical rivers, where it is an ambush predator.
Komodo dragon
The Komodo dragon is the largest living lizard (up to 3 meters). It lives in the Indonesian islands.
Koala
Koalas are herbivore marsupials that live in the eucalyptus forests of eastern Australia.
Ring-tailed lemur
The ring-tailed lemur is a primate that lives in the dry regions of southwest Madagascar. Its striped tail makes it easy to recognize.
Panda
The panda is a bear with black and white fur that lives in a few mountain ranges in central China. Pandas mostly eat bamboo.

Australia
Aboriginals were the first people to live in Australia. They sing and play instruments, like the didgeridoo. It is made from a log and can be up to five meters long!
Africa
Music is a part of everyday life in Africa. African music features a great variety of drums, and they believe it is a sacred and magical instrument.
Middle East
Music is a very important part of middle eastern culture. Specific songs are played to call worshipers to prayer. The lute is an instrument invented thousands of years ago and still in use today.
Japan
Taiko drumming comes from Japan. This type of drumming was originally used to scare enemies in battle. It is very loud, and performances are very exciting with crowds cheering and performers yelling!
Scotland and Ireland
Folk music of this region is called celtic music. It often incorporates a narrative poem or story. Typical instruments include bagpipes, fiddles, flutes, harps, and accordions.
Italy
Italy is famous for its Opera. Opera is a musical theater where actors tell a story by acting and singing. Opera singers, both male and female, learn special techniques to sing operas.
European Classical Music
Europe is the home of classical music. Famous composers like Bach, Beethoven, and Mozart forever changed music history.
Mexico
Mariachi is a famous type of Mexican music. It features guitars, trumpets, and violins. These bands play for many occasions, including weddings and parties.
United States of America
USA also has a wide variety of musical genres, but perhaps it is most famous for rock n' roll music. This music features vocalists, guitars, and drums.
